findings.statement: All 6 U-stages are enumerated as phases in epg.governance.universal, but epg.semantic.selfhosting — whose FIRST authority source is that document — does not list epg.governance.universal among its 3 modules (include=false).
findings.roundtrip_effect: Forward module resolution from the self-hosting card never reaches the ladder; it is restored only by profile composition: ["exploratory-five"]. A card-only consumer is incomplete; a profile-driven consumer is not.

findings.statement: SDK_SELF_HOSTING_DOGFOOD.md acceptance item 4 requires deliberately injecting a wrong wiki statement / stale fact / wrong symbol meaning and producing a minimal repro; no gate or phase in the self-hosting card or the governance card represents fault injection (only epg.visual.parity carries a negative_mutation phase).
findings.roundtrip_effect: The negative path that makes the positive path trustworthy is the part the contract drops.

findings.statement: The three crosswalk entries for these sources declare 3 unmapped_requirement string(s) in total; this audit produced 5 distinct unnormalised obligation clusters.
findings.roundtrip_effect: PARTIAL_MAPPING is honestly labelled, but the single generic gap text does not tell a later reader WHICH obligations were dropped, so nothing prompts their recovery.

verdict: PASS — audit executed and its detectors are falsifiable
